name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Private test: buildable lightrail connection using the measured bidirectional station profile.
description: Revision 13 adds UM Lightrail (Test) to the same build category as native tramtrack. Its simulation fields exactly match the mixed-mode STREET profile used inside the Bidirectional Stops; only menu and description differ. Revision-12 logs confirm complete local passages through both stops in both directions for all tested mode sets, but only a one-way complete route through ordinary double tramtrack. This narrows the issue outside the local station passages and motivates testing a matching connection. Replace only the intervening ordinary tramtrack with the new electric lightrail profile, keeping existing stops. No automatic conversion or save edits. Junction/road integration, complete line operation, native vehicle reversal and reservation safety remain unproven. Use a separate test save and no vehicle until the route is assessed.
